summary: Customer Satisfaction module (ISO 9001) fully tested end-to-end. 18/18 backend pytest cases passing including AI Gemini generation via Emergent LLM key. Public survey flow + admin flow + view modal + report tab + AI persistence all verified through Playwright.
critical_code_review_comments: customer_satisfaction_routes.py uses module-level Motor client + os.environ.get with defaults — already a pre-existing pattern in this codebase, low risk.
Pydantic ResponseSubmit accepts q_* as Optional[int]; the manual 1-5 check inside public_submit_response works but could be expressed with Pydantic Field(ge=1, le=5) for cleaner 422 errors.

CustomerSatisfactionPublicSurvey.js error display uses red Card without a class containing 'error' — automated test suites scanning standard error selectors will miss it. Consider adding role='alert' for accessibility and easier QA.
list_responses endpoint returns submitter_ip in the payload — this is PII and should probably be omitted from non-admin / per-row response views (admin-only is fine here, just noting).
seed_data_creation: Created TEST campaign for year 2099 inside pytest (auto-cleanup at end). Public survey UI test added one extra response to the live 2026 campaign (CSS-2026-002, company 'UI Test Co') which is harmless test data; admin can delete via UI if desired.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend route prefix is /api/customer-satisfaction. Pytest file /app/backend/tests/test_customer_satisfaction.py uses TEST_YEAR=2099 to avoid colliding with prod 2026 data, with full setup/teardown. The 2026 public_token in DB was rotated during testing (current token: HHm3ReqN5r9Lle_WrOaCEw at time of test). data-testids ai-generate-{year} and print-report-{year} exist only on the Report tab — switch to that tab first. View-response modal opens with the first eye icon in each row's action group; ratings render with labels like 'Very Satisfied (5/5)'.
